header.observed: Desktop: persistent top bar with logo (links home), primary nav (Approach, Solutions, Results, About) and a 'Get started' button. Mobile/narrow: a hamburger 'Open Menu' button toggles the nav; it becomes a 'Close Menu' button when open. Nav links are simple top-level links (no mega-menu/flyout observed).

homepage-hero.observed: Static hero: H1 'Harness the power of 101M+ loyalty members', eyebrow, supporting copy and a 'Get Started Now' CTA linking to /home/contact.html. Layered logo/media imagery. No rotation.

people-slider.observed: Audience/feature carousel with pagination dots ('Carousel Page 1/2/3') and a 'slide N of 3' live-region. Auto-advances on load (observed it move to slide 2 unprompted). Clicking a pagination dot moves the track and marks that page current. Each panel has an eyebrow, heading, bullet list and a 'See <name>'s Story' CTA.

featured-solutions.observed: On the homepage renders as three static solution columns (In-store, Onsite & Owned, Offsite Digital), each with image, heading, copy and a 'View ... Solutions' link to the relevant solution-detail page. No tab switching observed on the homepage instance.

callout.observed: Results band: eyebrow + bold claim ('Delivering 20% average incremental sales lift...') with 'See more results' and 'See our insights' links. A background variation is used for emphasis.

case-studies-cards.observed: Case-study card carousel ('slide N of 2') — cards show category eyebrow, title and a KPI pill (e.g. '23x performance'); each links to a case-study page (/home/case-studies/beauty.html, /ai.html).

logo-slider.observed: Partner-logo band under a heading ('Offering best-in-class media, tech and data abilities'); a row of provider logos.

footer-teaser.observed: Pre-footer CTA band: 'Build your brand and boost your SALES' with a "Let's go" button (opens the contact flow).

footer.observed: Mega-footer: logo (home), tagline, LinkedIn link, nav column (Approach/Insights/Solutions/About/Results/Careers), a 'contact us' button, copyright, and legal links (Notice of Privacy Practices → jsp-redirect, Terms of Use). Present on every page.

solutions-hero.observed: Solutions overview hero with H1 and an auto-animating image slider ('slide N of 3') plus a 'stop animation' toggle button to pause the animation.

featured-circles.observed: Three static circular feature callouts (Your Customer / Your Choices / Your Results) under a heading — informational, no interaction.

solution-carousel.observed: Carousel of solution channels (In-store / O&O / Offsite) each with imagery, heading, copy and a 'See ... Solutions' link to the matching solution-detail page.

insight-search.observed: Filterable insights list. Left rail has checkbox filters grouped by Types / Topics / Solutions, plus 'Apply filters' and 'Clear all'. Filtering is CLIENT-SIDE: checking 'Measurement' and clicking Apply narrowed the results grid from 3 cards to 1 ('Pioneering change with programmatic leaders') with NO page reload (URL unchanged). Result cards link to insight articles.

insight-hero.observed: Featured-insight hero: heading, 'Featured' badge and a CTA to the featured article.

contact-hero.observed: Contact page with a lead form of 7 fields (First name, Last name, Company, Brand, Email, Phone — all required; Message — optional) and a 'SUBMIT FORM' button. Client-side validation: submitting empty shows per-field 'X is required' errors. The form POSTs to Salesforce Web-to-Lead (https://webto.salesforce.com/servlet/servlet.WebToLead). Also shows a testimonial quote and links to LinkedIn and the external jobs site.

approach-hero.observed: Approach hero with heading + a prominent stat (101,000,000+ members) and a category-stat carousel ('slide N of 3', pagination dots) cycling category figures (Household & Grocery, Beauty, Health & Wellness). Auto-advances.

flip-circles.observed: Grid of circular audience-segment tiles (Shaving Needs, Beauty, Skin Care, Acne, New Parents, etc.). Each circle shows a label + image; interacting (hover) surfaces the segment. Interactive card grid.

featured-people.observed: Persona narrative ('Meet Maria') — a sequence of stacked panels (photo + heading + copy) telling one customer's shopping story; scroll-driven sequential reveal.

card-carousel.observed: Carousel of content cards (heading + 'Contact us to get started' CTA to /home/contact.html) with pagination dots ('slide N of 3'); auto-advances.

icon-carousel.observed: Process/steps carousel (Identify goals → Understand your customers → Plan your campaign) with step icons and a 'Let's go' CTA; prev/next style navigation.

feature-text.observed: Large statement text ('The Walgreens customer is everyone...') with a scroll-triggered 'reveal' animation variation and a 'Read their stories' CTA.

results-cards.observed: Grid of result/case-study cards (title + KPI like 'Over 6x ROAS') with a 'Load more' control to reveal additional cards; each links to a case study.

results-hero.observed: Hero with H1 'Proven effectiveness' and prominent KPI stats ($5 avg ROAS, 3.4% ...) with footnotes.

solutions-detail-hero.observed: Large solution-detail hero (H1 + multiple offering sub-sections with many links/CTAs). Offerings presented with anchored navigation into offsite/onsite solutions.

testimonial.observed: Quote block with attribution (name/role); multiple testimonials present (careers page shows several employee quotes).
